title: Bivariate topological complexity: a framework for coordinated motion planning
summary: We introduce a bivariate version of topological complexity, $\mathrm{TC}(f,g)$, associated with two continuous maps $f\colon X\to Z$ and $g\colon Y\to Z$. This invariant measures the minimal number of continuous motion planning rules required to coordinate trajectories in $X$ and $Y$ through a shared target space $Z$. It recovers Farber's classical topological complexity when $f=g=\mathrm{id}_X$ and Pavešić's map-based invariant when one of the maps is the identity.
